method.rust: RUSTFLAGS=-C instrument-coverage CRUSTIFY_FFMPEG_VARIANT=coverage; cargo +nightly test -p ffmpeg --lib --tests --no-fail-fast -- --skip compile_fail; nightly llvm-profdata merge + llvm-cov report/show over the lib, equiv, ub_safe and ub_unsafe binaries, for libavutil/hwcontext.rs (the workset is its lines 2746-3489: FramesContext, its hooks and pool, DeviceReferenceRef::create_frames, FramesReferenceRef::context) and libavutil/frame.rs (the review's typed hw_frames_ctx accessors and copy refusal)
method.c: the same run with GCOV_PREFIX into a private dir; gcov 13 -b -c -f over src/libavutil/hwcontext.c and src/libavutil/frame.c with the coverage build's .gcno
method.trees: base: the wave tip ad5932bb53; fixed: the landed tree (the tip after the symbol review's test commit 32b6b94e4d, plus this review)
method.note: Inside the workset's range the only line never run is release_frames_hooks' NULL-handle arm (hwcontext.rs:2879): hwframe_ctx_free always passes the live context, so it is unreachable. The review's new unit test alloc_fails_whole_when_the_backend_struct_does_not_fit covers av_hwframe_ctx_alloc's failure on the backend's frames struct and its fail path (hwcontext.c:279, 302-306) through a test backend whose frames struct (4 KiB, as Vulkan's private one) is larger than the context. The two remaining misses there (hwcontext.c:284 av_buffer_ref of the device, :290 av_buffer_create) are allocations smaller than the context, which no av_max_alloc limit isolates. The rest of hwcontext.c's misses are backend paths: hw_table is empty under --disable-autodetect.
